hero.headline: Quality South African Timber. Family Owned for Over 80 Years.
hero.subheading: Plantation pine and eucalyptus, sawn and treated in Ngome for builders, pallet makers, farmers and homeowners across KZN.

intro.heading: Timber know-how, four generations deep
intro.text: Thorpe Timbers is a family-owned sawmill in Ngome, northern KwaZulu-Natal. Our family has worked in the South African timber industry since the 1940s, and four generations on we bring that experience to every log we cut, from structural pine for roof trusses to treated gum poles, pallet material, firewood and shavings.

trustPoints.title: Family owned
trustPoints.text: Run by the family, not a corporate

products.heading: What we produce
products.text: From construction timber to by-products, we make full use of every log. All pricing is on request.

cta.heading: Need timber? Let's talk.
cta.text: Call, email or WhatsApp us for a quote. Tell us what you need and how much, and we'll come back to you quickly.
